description:
Brand New Single from Bay Area Singer, Producer, Instrumentalist Xiomara (She/Her) , kicking off the oncoming release of her brand new Self-Produced album titled “Sistas”.
“Chardonnay” features co-production by prolific, Grammy winning artist Son Little, and more! 
Brought to you just in time to celebrate National Chardonnay Day! 

Be sure to follow on social media for Updates & Exclusives!
